deviations: LSP methods are generic methods on InputBaseState[M] (EditorState is an alias of an instantiated type); exported ones panic on other modes
provider tasks return gpui.Task[ProviderResult[T]]; trait defaults as optional interfaces plus package functions
resolve_completions not ported: its item type lsp_types::request::Completion is an empty request-marker enum and Base never calls it
lsp types: Lsp prefix, Position = InputPosition, Uri as string, serde_json::Value as json.RawMessage, unions as structs, no JSON tags (no transport in Base); CodeAction keeps Title only
DiagnosticEntry.range is ByteRange (the embedded Diagnostic has Range)
debounces are cancellable background sleeps; nothing spawns after App.Shutdown
document-color RGBA->HSLA ported locally (the core's float version is unexported), checked against RgbaToHsla
on_hover_definition is wired; its only upstream caller is the unported native context menu
